text:
omar: Noticing a sharp uptick in fncall validation rejects on the canary around 09:06 UTC. Reject rate ~6x and a lot of traffic is routing to the degen fallback. Console sampling is tiny so we can't inspect payloads.

jess: Canary only? Any user-visible errors yet? :eyes:

omar: Only canary for now. No customer reports but fallback churn is inflating costs. Need payload samples and quick telemetry.

ben: I deployed validators:v2.7.0-canary this morning with a stricter union->array coercion to catch malformed tool outputs. That could be surfacing here.

claire: The stricter flag was deliberate for canary. Might be hitting adapters that emit a scalar instead of an array for attachments.

omar: Sanitized log line: [09:07:11Z] route=fncall-eu-canary validator=validators:v2.7.0-canary outcome=REJECT reason="attachments expected array, got string"

jess: Console only shows aggregate rejects. Can we get a short-lived panel that breaks down rejects by validator_version, route, fallback_route and sample_rate? Also an inspector for redacted payload+model response would help.

ben: I can cut validators:v2.7.1 with a soft-coercion toggle and a debug backfill endpoint. Requesting sample override: route=fncall-eu-canary event=reject sample=100% duration=30m. Will flow through redact pipeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting roll validators:v2.7.1 -> canary (owner: @ben)

jess: Approved: sample override 100% for 30m. Enable redact pipeline and add audit note. :white_check_mark:

product: product: To avoid canary-induced billing surprises, implement a console-level "shadow-sandbox" toggle that routes fallback traffic to an observability-only path (no billing, no quota consumption) while still surfacing metrics. Default shadow on canaries.

ben: Will add routing_tag=shadow.sandbox and emit metrics validation.reject_mode={hard,soft,coerced} and routing.fallback_type={shadow,real}. Also add fallback_cost_estimate histogram so PMs can see impact. Telemetry ingestion will mark shadowed events as non-billable.

claire: Dashboard inspector should include validator fingerprint, adapter id, and a redacted payload + model reply to triage adapter vs model vs validator.

omar: Short-term runbook: if samples show adapter produced wrong shape -> revert adapter; if model output deviates -> revert validator strictness and run focused evals.

alert-bot: alert-bot: created incident INC-2026-9991 "canary-fncall-validate spike" (owner: eng-platform)

jess: Ben/Omar please post 2 redacted examples here when backfill completes and link the new dashboard. Keep rollback options ready. :thumbsup:
